answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unknown when agents must act; the pulse then derives the task instance, nonce domain, and scoring salt. Thus, a sybil swarm cannot precompute valid answers, reuse offline farms, or selectively discard unfavorable trials. A spiral of identities gains no leverage: every raven faces fresh entropy, while each ripple of parallel attempts remains independently bound to the unbiasable beacon.
